recommendation: Keep the external-repo audit commit. Any future update to the manufacturing batch extension, including possible R6 Medication.instance context alignment, packageSize interaction, or wording refinements, should be handled in the FHIR Extension Pack with Pharmacy work-group review rather than in this core reconciliation branch.
issue_request: FHIR-29575 was Published with resolution Persuasive with Modification. It requested Container Fill/Container Fill Unit for Medication.Batch, with examples such as 100 tablets, 10 mL, 1 patch, or 1 sachet. The resolution was to create a core extension for the attribute.
initial_application: No FHIR-29575-tagged source commit was found in core or Extension Pack history. Historical core source did contain source/medication/structuredefinition-extension-medication-manufacturingBatch.xml with a container.quantity slice covering amount or volume of drug product in the container, Pharmacy minutes record that the PQ/CMC manufacturing extension was created and added to the build, and dd468d4f17 later removed the core extension file as part of moving extensions out of the R5 source.
additional_context: The current HL7/fhir checkout is R6 ballot source: Medication is active in source/fhir.ini, has Medication.packageSize for package-level amount information, and now uses Medication.instance after FHIR-47622. The FHIR Extension Pack checkout contains input/definitions/multiple/StructureDefinition-medication-manufacturingBatch.xml with the canonical medication-manufacturingBatch extension, Medication.batch/Substance context, and the requested container.quantity Ratio slice. Community evidence found a 2022 Zulip thread where the reporter profiled that standard extension and used container.quantity as Container Fill per Container Size.
reconciliation: No HL7/fhir source change was made. The requested extension content exists in the Extension Pack, and the old core extension file's absence from current HL7/fhir is consistent with the deliberate extension migration.

related_jiras.note: Another Published PQ/CMC Medication.Batch extension request represented by the same medication-manufacturingBatch extension and already audited on the combined branch.
Later Applied/Persuasive Pharmacy issue renamed Medication.batch to Medication.instance in current core; it was reviewed only to interpret current context and was not decided here.
